article.title: Newsom returns to a defining California fight: Who pays for wildfire damage?
article.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom is asking state lawmakers to shield utilities from financial trouble if their equipment sparks a wildfire by limiting the amount they have to pay victims and attorneys.
